title: Scripts, approvals, versions và asset briefs
scope_items: Database Migration 00014: Created scripts, asset_briefs, scenes, shot_lists, approval_requests, and script_versions tables with composite workspace tenant keys, tenant RLS isolation, foreign keys to workspaces, and narrow role grants; reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (Stale approval fails): Optimistic concurrency and stale review detection (EC-M06-003). Reviewers submitting approve/reject against an outdated script version or snapshot timestamp fail with CodeFailedPrecondition ErrStaleReviewConflict; non-pending approval state fails with ErrApprovalStateNotPending.

Acceptance Target 2 (Rejection reason validated): Manager rejection enforces actionable feedback with at least 10 non-whitespace characters (RULE-M06-002, EC-M06-002). Rejections with shorter feedback return CodeInvalidArgument and remain in pending_approval. Valid rejections transition to rejected and revision_required, emitting script.rejected event.

Acceptance Target 3 (Ready-for-production requires approval and complete brief): Lifecycle transition to ready_for_production requires approval_state == 'approved' and a complete Asset Brief with output_type, target_format, target_duration_seconds > 0, and non-empty continuity_requirements_json (RULE-M06-005, RULE-M06-006, AC-2). Emits script.ready_for_production with script_id and asset_brief_id.
Empty scenes block submission: Submission for review enforces EC-M06-001; scripts with 0 scenes or empty scene content fail validation and cannot transition to in_review.
Commercial Offer Hooks & Auto-Disclosure: Commercial offer hooks auto-suggest legal disclosure blocks (RULE-M06-007).

Channel Rewrite & Multi-Platform Adaptation: Script duplication across channels (TikTok, YouTube, Reels) creates independent script records while preserving origin idea_id and adapting format and duration (RULE-M06-004, AC-4).
Version Snapshots & Rollback: Automatic version snapshotting on creation and mutation; supports listing, diffing, and rolling back previous versions (Alternate Flow A3).
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_StaleApprovalFails (Go -race), Vitest unit tests (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm stale approval/rejection rejection with 409/FailedPrecondition.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_RejectionReasonValidated (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm rejection validation requiring >= 10 characters and pending_approval retention on invalid reasons.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_ReadyForProductionRequiresApprovalAndCompleteBrief (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm ready-for-production gating on both manager approval and complete Asset Brief.
Empty Scenes Block Submission Verified: TestEmptyScenesBlockSubmission (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm EC-M06-001 empty scene rejection.
Channel Rewrite Verified: TestChannelRewriteProducesIndependentScriptWithSameIdea (Go -race), Svelte channel rewrite drawer, and Flutter tests confirm idea_id retention.
Migration 00014 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior pass for all 14 migrations including 00014 up, down, and RLS checks.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, codegen drift check, backward compatibility, Go vet/mod, TypeScript compile/vitest, Dart analyze/test.

Web & Mobile Quality Gates Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check 0/0, vite build, 129 web tests + 6 admin tests), check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /scripts), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze 0 issues + 115 tests) all pass.
